newsitem.title: UK: Robert Fraser suspends shares pending deal.
newsitem.headline: Robert Fraser suspends shares pending deal.

text.p: Robert Fraser Asset Management Plc said it had suspended trading in its shares on Thursday pending a possible takeover deal.

"A transaction is currently being considered which may lead to a significant change in the company, including changes to the board, the name and the capital structure of the company," the firm said in a statement.

"The change in the capital structure would arise from the issue of a substantial number of new shares in respect of an acquisition of a company having substantially greater assets than are currently held by the company," it said.
The shares were frozen at 2.5p, half-way between the year high of 3.0p and low of 2.0p.
